user_prompt: Implement Work Shifts, Holidays, Personnel Requests, and Attendance Reports (daily/monthly/yearly) using raw sqlite3 stores, reusing existing Personnel and Detection infrastructure.
selected_options_or_behaviors: shifts: CRUD for work shifts with weekday flags, overnight support
holidays: CRUD with annual recurrence, Jalali date support, active/inactive
holidays: Check if a date is a holiday (including annual recurrence)
requests: CRUD for personnel requests (leave, sick_leave, remote_work, mission, overtime, personal, other)
requests: Approval workflow (approve/reject with overlap prevention)
attendance: Daily summary (present/absent, delay, early leave, overtime)
attendance: Monthly summary (gregorian and jalali calendar)
attendance: Yearly leave summary (leave, sick, mission, remote, personal days)
attendance: Log attendance toggle (set counts_for_attendance flag on detection logs)
prompt_enrichment: All stores use raw sqlite3 with RLock pattern matching existing PersonnelStore/LocationStore convention
ShiftStore adds shift_id column to personnel table via ALTER TABLE migration (no FK constraint to avoid ordering issues)
HumanLogStore gets personnel_id and counts_for_attendance columns via ALTER TABLE migration
personnel_id extracted from ref_img_id='personnel_<id>' format set by face enrollment API
AttendanceService uses Tehran timezone (+3:30) for business day calculations
Overnight shifts (e.g. 22:00→06:00) supported with correct duration calculation
Jalali dates supported in all date inputs (year 1200-1500 range detected as Jalali)
Attendance delay/early-leave computed against shift max_minutes_delay/max_minutes_early thresholds
Attendance overtime capped at shift max_overtime_hours
Overlap prevention for approved requests of same type for same person

evidence: Store CRUD pattern matches existing PersonnelStore
Date check with annual recurrence support
Daily summary with presence computation from human_logs
Monthly summary and performance with gregorian/jalali support
Yearly leave/sick/mission/remote/personal day counts from approved requests
Toggle counts_for_attendance flag on detection logs

safe_assumptions: Tehran timezone = +3:30 constant (no DST adjustment, matching existing jalali_utils.py)
Attendance presence computed from overlapping human_log detection intervals
Minimum 60 seconds of detection counts as 'present'
Shift deletion sets personnel.shift_id to NULL (application-level cascade)
Holiday soft-delete sets is_active=0 rather than physical removal
